learning_outcomes.text: Consolidate knowledge in the field of Dynamics and understand the relationship between Dynamics and other general technical disciplines.
Assimilate basic knowledge applicable in the development of other specialized disciplines.
Develop the ability to solve fundamental elementary mechanical engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Dynamics of systems of material points and rigid bodies
Dynamics of the material point (practical applications)
Dynamics of the rigid body (practical applications)

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (2 theoretical subjects and 2 problems)

assessment_rules: To pass the discipline, students must correctly solve and approach at least half of each proposed subject in the evaluation. The final grade is a weighted average of the written exam (67%) and seminar activities (33%).
